name: deconstruct
description: This skill should be used when the user wants to deconstruct a workflow, break down a business process, capture requirements for an AI workflow, or turn a workflow from their backlog into a clear, testable description of what it must do. It starts from anything already written down, shapes the outcome first (a goal and yes-or-no checks), then how the work gets done, the rules, where a person checks or approves the work, the sources it uses and practice inputs, and saves them as the workflow's requirements for the Design step; small, low-risk workflows get a shorter version. Also use when the user says "continue my workflow" and the workflow needs its requirements: none yet, an unfinished Deconstruct interview, or a big change sent back from Design; and when the user asks to run the deconstruct skill on work that already runs outside the framework (an in-production Workflow node with no workflow folder), to bring it in. This is the Deconstruct step of the AI Workflow Framework.
